sites.name: Katse Dam reservoir rim raster lows
sites.basis: Repair only invalid low samples near the mapped reservoir and crest.

sites.name: Katse Dam eastern bank raster lows
sites.basis: Repair isolated invalid terrain samples beneath the east abutment and approach.

sites.name: Katse Dam gorge raster lows
sites.basis: Repair implausibly low samples in the plunge-pool gorge.

sites.name: Katse Dam west crest road tie
sites.basis: Match the rendered access road to the west end of the deck.

sites.name: Katse Dam east crest road tie
sites.basis: Match the rendered crest road and service junction to the east end of the deck.

sites.name: Katse Dam central downstream concrete face
sites.basis: The standard raster smears the concrete wall into the valley. Reveal the open downstream face inside the gorge and blend into the banks.

sites.name: Katse Dam east inner gorge shoulder
sites.basis: The photograph shows the concrete face above the inner gorge bank. Take the narrow artificial ridge out of the open view and tie into the outer hillside.

sites.name: Katse Dam east abutment shoulder
sites.basis: Keep a rising bank toward the eastern abutment and retain the outer hillside and service road.

waterStages.name: Katse Reservoir
waterStages.basis: Representative full supply stage below the crest road.

waterStages.name: Malibamatso at Katse Dam
waterStages.basis: The two mapped water polygons flank the lower dam. Classify their stages in the lower dam frame.

waterStages.name: Katse low outlet conduit
waterStages.basis: The mapped conduit runs below the concrete. Native water uses the mapped plunge pool.

waterStageNotes: Representative water stages. The mapped Malibamatso polygons separate at the lower dam. Its signed frame determines the plunge pool and tailwater stages.
